newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl Oriental places 500 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Pearl Oriental places 500 mln warrants.

text.p: Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd said it had entered into an agreement with underwriters on Monday on the placement of 500 million warrants issued by the company.

The warrants were to be issued at HK$1 each conferring right to subscribe for Pearl Oriental shares an exercise price of HK$3.35 each, the share's closing price on Monday, the firm said in a statement. It is engaged in commercial property trading and development, project management, hotel management and consultancy.
Dealing in the warrants is expected to start on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on November 5, 1996.
The underwriters, Goodwill Investment Services Ltd and Hani Securities (H.K.) Ltd, would place the warrants to independent investors and securities dealers on an underwritten basis.

Gross placing proceeds from the warrant issue, before underwriting commission and relevant expenses, would be HK$500 million. The proceeds would be used to acquire a five-star hotel in Portuguese-administered Macau and to expand the group's international hotel network.
Chairman Wong Kwan said in the statement he believed the warrant placement would result in new funds to the extent of HK$1.68 billion within two years upon exercise of the warrants.
